preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a binary string composed only of characters '0' and '1'
N is the length of the binary string S
The length of S is at least 1

postconditions.description: stdout is the maximum number of occurrences of the substring '01' in any string obtainable by swapping characters at indices of the same parity (both odd or both even) in S

postconditions.expression: max_count == max(sum(1 for i in range(len(S)-1) if S[i] == '0' and S[i+1] == '1') for S in obtainable_strings)
postconditions.description: max_count is the maximum count of '01' substrings across all strings obtainable by swapping characters at indices of the same parity in S
obtainable_strings is the set of all strings that can be formed by swapping characters at indices of the same parity in S

postconditions.expression: swap_parity(S) == {S} if all(i % 2 == j % 2 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)) if S[i] != S[j]) else {S, *generate_swaps(S)}
postconditions.description: swap_parity(S) is the set of all strings formed by swapping characters at indices of the same parity in S, including S itself

postconditions.expression: generate_swaps(S) == {swap(S, i, j) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)) if i % 2 == j % 2 and S[i] != S[j]}
postconditions.description: generate_swaps(S) is the set of all strings formed by swapping any two characters at indices of the same parity in S
